title: Colts want to "find ways to take some of that workload" off Jonathan Taylor

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts want to "find ways to take some of that workload" off Jonathan Taylor
sources.description: Only two running backs in the NFL have carried the ball more than 300 times in each of the last two seasons, but it sounds like the Colts wouldn't mind if Jonathan Taylor's streak ends there.
